supersedes_in_part: evidence/ep-kv-rdma-coscheduling-2026-11-17.json (that record is unchanged; this record corrects its abstract-level DualPath characterization and its 'open for inference' verdict, based on the downloaded full texts)
scope: Full-text reread of the papers archived as ids 52-59 for proposal 06, done after download. Line numbers refer to the PDFKit-extracted text in paper-text/; page numbers are the extractor's '===== PDF PAGE N =====' markers. This record does not establish framework support or network performance.

dualpath_correction.previous_characterization: Abstract-level subagent reading (recorded in ep-kv-rdma-coscheduling-2026-11-17.json): DualPath isolates the KV load path by route/NIC choice, without traffic classes, QoS or virtual lanes.

full_text_findings.claim: Identifies that additional KV-Cache transfer traffic on the compute network may interfere with latency-sensitive collectives including AllToAll in expert parallel and ReduceScatter/AllGather in TP/CP.
full_text_findings.location: §4 'Traffic isolation', text lines 619-628, PDF page 6; also §1 lines 137-147, PDF page 2

full_text_findings.claim: States that because collectives occur in rapid sub-millisecond bursts, a software-based traffic shaper interleaving lower-priority I/O between high-priority windows is impractical; consolidates all GPU traffic through the paired compute NIC to use native network QoS.

On InfiniBand, maps model inference traffic to a dedicated high-priority VL and all other traffic including KV-Cache transfer to a low-priority VL; VL arbiters on switches and NICs use weighted round-robin reserving about 99% of bandwidth for the high-priority VL.
full_text_findings.location: §5.1, text lines 664-678, PDF page 7; configuration values in Appendix A.1 lines 1721-1732, PDF page 16

full_text_findings.claim: Describes a RoCE realization using DSCP-to-TC mapping with hardware queues, four lossless RDMA TCs with PFC enabled, and proportional TC scheduling weights.
full_text_findings.location: §5.1 lines 679-688, PDF page 7; Appendix A.1 lines 1733-1742, PDF page 16

full_text_findings.claim: Experiments are conducted on an InfiniBand-interconnected cluster with eight 400Gbps RDMA NICs per node; the RoCE design is described, not evaluated.
full_text_findings.location: §5.1 line 679 ('Although our experiments are conducted on an InfiniBand-based network'), PDF page 7; §7 Testbed lines 931-938, PDF page 9

full_text_findings.claim: The §7.5 ablation separates layerwise prefill, dual-path loading and the scheduling algorithm; no with/without traffic-isolation comparison or interference magnitude measurement was found in this reread.
Allocates a small amount of DRAM as buffers on each prefill and decode engine (PE buffer, DE buffer).
Authors include DeepSeek-AI affiliation; evaluated models include DeepSeek-V3/V3.2 660B (MLA).

dualpath_correction.consequence_for_proposal_06: Interference between KV transfer and EP AllToAll, static hardware priority isolation, and DRAM buffering are covered by DualPath. Proposal 06 is narrowed to: measured residual coupling of DSCP/TC isolation on the AMD RoCE stack; scheduler-level coordination of the low-priority class's residual capacity with prefill release, KV handoff and TTFT after isolation; static vs load-aware TC weights; MLA small-message and cross-node decode EP applicability. Sub-millisecond software interleaving is retained only as a feasibility comparator.

other_rereads.name: ExpertPlex
other_rereads.finding: Interference arises because shared experts couple the phases: traffic flows from prefill and decode to the same MoE module interfere; uses attention-initiated one-sided MoE communication over mostly disjoint network paths. Not about P->D KV transfer.
other_rereads.location: abstract lines 20-37, PDF page 1; intro lines 112-137, PDF page 2

other_rereads.name: MegaScale-Infer
other_rereads.finding: Ping-pong pipeline over micro-batches and an M2N communication library compared against NCCL and perftest; no KV-vs-EP coexistence analysis found.

other_rereads.name: TraCT
other_rereads.finding: States every KV hit traverses NIC and DRAM on both sides even with high prefix reuse, making the RDMA path sensitive to network congestion; replaces the RDMA hop with CXL shared memory.

other_rereads.name: Topology-Aware Data Movement
other_rereads.finding: Presents analytical bandwidth models, component implementations and projected analysis; full evaluation stated to require hardware beyond academic resources.

other_rereads.name: Lina
other_rereads.finding: Prioritizes all-to-all over concurrent allreduce in training.

other_rereads.name: CASSINI
other_rereads.finding: Computes time-shift values so jobs sharing a link interleave communication phases.

other_rereads.name: MLCC
other_rereads.finding: Augments congestion control to interleave DNN training jobs' communication.
